style: Rolling drum and bass at 174 with a soft break, brushed hats and a deep round sub that rolls rather than bites. A grand piano opens it alone on a slow falling figure, three lines before any drums, then the beat lands on 'you keep on walking'. The piano answers him at the end of every line and comes back an octave higher each section. Wide, warm and tape-soft, night-bus melancholy. Two English grime MCs trade the verses, loud and in front, one gruff and raw, one clipped and cold, hurt and close, half-speaking and half-singing the ends of lines, flat and raw and never tuned, unhurried and clear.
exclude: American accent, American vocal, US rap, trap, autotune, pitch-corrected vocals, female vocal, cheesy, steady rap pace, double-time, motormouth, shouting, screaming, roaring, major key, tempo change, slow tempo, half time, jump up, wobble bass, neurofunk, dubstep, EDM drops, glossy production, happy, uplifting, orchestral bed, symphony orchestra, full orchestra, string section, church organ, male choir, crowd vocals, synth strings, garage shuffle, jungle
